## How to test

- [ ] `python tools/serve.py` and open http://localhost:8000
- [ ] Play at least one record and press **Describe now**
- [ ] Keyboard only: <kbd>Space</kbd>, <kbd>←</kbd>/<kbd>→</kbd>, <kbd>V</kbd> (voice mode)

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run check` pass
- [ ] New visualizations have `see` / `hear` descriptions and SVS credits
- [ ] Data → sound mapping is documented in the README if it changed
